presentation_recipe_register.note: Companion register. This file answers 'is this DRAWING of a gameplay object accepted' (the atlas chain). That file answers 'is this VISIBLE LANGUAGE for disposable presentation accepted' (the recipe chain). The two identity spaces must stay disjoint: a recipe verdict may never confer acceptance on an atlas asset, and an asset verdict may never cover a recipe.

release_policy.note: PERMANENT rules. These never empty and must never be asserted empty. They state what makes a release unacceptable, not what is currently wrong.
rules: A nonblank emitted cell with no visual_source_id is anonymous paint and blocks a release.
A visual_source_id naming no record in either register is unknown paint and blocks a release.
A reachable visual source blocks a release when its verdict is not accepted or accepted_as_deployed.
review_candidates may appear only in the local unreleased review surface. It never licenses a production deploy.
A recipe_id and an asset_id may never be equal.
A recipe record may never carry an object_id, at any nesting depth; object_id is inherited only from canonical projection.
Paint location is never a release criterion. Renderer-local paint is permitted; anonymous paint is not.
A law is never the visual source of an emitted cell. A law decides how cells look and is reached through law_refs; naming one as a cell's source hides which recipe drew it.

Acceptance and presence are separate. 'The operator asked for this' (presence_requirement) never substitutes for a verdict on the drawing, and a required presentation that is absent blocks a release exactly as a rejected one does.
A source reference is provenance, not approval. Only a decision_ref resolving to a real anchor, quoting the operator verbatim, is evidence that anything was accepted.

active_release_blockers.note: COMPUTED conditions, recomputed by scripts/validate_presentation_identity.py. This list can legitimately become empty, and a root-product deploy requires exactly that. Do not hand-edit: regenerate. The KEYS below are asserted to equal the keys the validator returns, so a condition cannot be added in code and left undocumented here, or described here and never computed. TEMPORARY EXCEPTION: unresolvable_paint_call_forms and writers_that_cannot_record_identity are frozen static-analyzer diagnostics retained only as a conservative stop sign until the public runtime-frame invariant lands. They are not acceptance authority and must be deleted, along with the writer graph and synthetic internal-Raster authority, in the same patch that installs the runtime PresentationFrame check.

conditions.unaccepted_atlas_assets: atlas assets whose verdict is not accepted
conditions.unaccepted_recipes: registered recipes whose verdict is not accepted or accepted_as_deployed
conditions.required_presentation_absent: recipes the operator required whose candidate counterpart is absent or rejected; here the DEFECT IS THE ABSENCE, so no amount of correct drawing elsewhere clears it
conditions.anonymous_paint_sites: renderer calls that emit cells while carrying no visual source id
conditions.unknown_visual_source_ids: paint calls naming an id that neither register defines
conditions.laws_used_as_cell_sources: paint calls naming a law as their source, which hides the recipe that actually drew them
conditions.divergent_implementations_claiming_appro: paint calls citing an accepted_as_deployed id from an implementation that does not reproduce the deployed one, which launders an unreviewed drawing through an approved id
conditions.unrecognised_paint_methods: raster methods the identity checker does not classify as writer or reader, so a new paint path cannot become exempt by being unrecognised
conditions.gameplay_art_outside_atlas: plantArt, animalArt, collectibleArt and the fixtureArt fallback, painted renderer-locally with no per-asset verdict row and not yet versioned atlas assets
conditions.unresolvable_paint_call_forms: FROZEN DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, not acceptance authority. This is the last retained output of the refused static-analyzer method family: every way of reaching a writer other than a plain member call, refused as a family rather than as a list of examples. It remains only as a conservative stop sign until the runtime PresentationFrame check can read actual emitted primitives. Do not add more invocation forms or treat this as proof of runtime identity. Delete this key in the same patch that installs the public runtime-frame invariant.
conditions.writers_that_cannot_record_identity: FROZEN DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, not acceptance authority. This is the last retained output of the refused writer-graph/internal-Raster analysis: the current Raster writers could not give a cell a visual source id even if every call declared one. It remains only as a conservative stop sign until identity is checked on emitted PresentationFrame primitives. Do not extend the writer graph, storage-pattern list or synthetic Raster authority. Delete this key in the same patch that installs the public runtime-frame invariant.

registry_invariants_note: Invariants this registry asserts about ITSELF, named by ID. The sentences behind the IDs live in scripts/validate_presentation_identity.py (REGISTRY_INVARIANTS), which is the only place they can be changed. There is deliberately no free-form list here: a rule written in prose reads as authority to the next person while no check can tell it apart from the rules that belong. Release conditions are not invariants and are not here -- they live in release_policy (permanent) and active_release_blockers (computed).
